hero.context: Dhu al-Hijjah 6 opens with Iran drawing two red lines at once -- uranium stays home and Hormuz control stays in play -- while the AI money race gets louder by the hour. OpenAI is lining up a filing, Anthropic is nearing another mega-round, Meta is cutting thousands to fund AI, and SpaceX's S-1 reads like infrastructure doctrine. Egypt's board is more practical today: higher electricity tariffs are now more visible, and Cairo is pitching itself as a grain hub as Eid al-Adha approaches.

videoRecommendations.storyTitle: Egypt's new electricity tariff sheet shows deeper hikes for major users than the first messaging suggested
videoRecommendations.storyContext: This is the practical Egypt card today: the war-cost shock is now visible in bills for commercial users, utilities and higher brackets.
videoRecommendations.label: Egypt
videoRecommendations.storySummary: Recent tariff sheets and local reporting show hikes reaching roughly 15% to 31% across several service and high-usage categories, with metro, water, irrigation and commercial users among those facing bigger increases. Cairo says lower household brackets stay protected, but the inflation pass-through risk is real.
videoRecommendations.searchQuery: Egypt electricity tariffs May 2026 Ahram Mada Masr
videoRecommendations.internalReason: High personal-impact Egypt story. Video search stayed generic, so the text card is cleaner than forcing a weak clip.

videoRecommendations.storyTitle: Anthropic is close to a new $30B-plus round that could value it above $900B
videoRecommendations.storyContext: This keeps the AI wall balanced: OpenAI may reach public markets first, but Anthropic is still pulling in private capital at extraordinary scale.
videoRecommendations.label: Anthropic
videoRecommendations.storySummary: Bloomberg says Anthropic could close a new financing round as soon as next week, with Sequoia, Dragoneer, Altimeter and Greenoaks expected to co-lead. If it lands above a $900B valuation, it vaults back into the top tier of the AI power race just as OpenAI's IPO clock starts.
videoRecommendations.internalReason: Important Anthropic capital-markets update, but the available video coverage was either generic IPO chatter or stale.

videoRecommendations.storyTitle: An OpenAI model just broke a famous Erdos conjecture in discrete geometry
videoRecommendations.storyContext: This is the pure AI breakthrough slot: not product marketing, but a genuine research milestone people will talk about.
videoRecommendations.label: OpenAI
videoRecommendations.storySummary: OpenAI says a general-purpose reasoning model found an infinite family of counterexamples to the long-standing unit-distance conjecture, with the proof checked by external mathematicians and accompanied by a human-written explanation. It is one of the clearest "AI did real science" stories of the month.
videoRecommendations.internalReason: Huge fit for the user's OpenAI and AI-breakthrough preference, but the official video is brief and more announcement-like than a full TV segment, so text is better.

videoRecommendations.storyTitle: Egypt is pitching itself as a regional grain hub with Russian exporters and new storage infrastructure
videoRecommendations.storyContext: Under the noise, this is a serious Egypt food-security story with long-tail impact on bread, supply chains and leverage.
videoRecommendations.label: Egypt
videoRecommendations.storySummary: Supply Minister Sherif Farouk said Egypt wants a major grain trading, storage and processing hub, with new elevators, transport links and port-side facilities tied to Russian wheat exporters. The point is resilience: bigger reserves, clearer tracking and more bargaining power on a strategic commodity.
videoRecommendations.searchQuery: Egypt grain hub Russia May 2026 Reuters
videoRecommendations.internalReason: Direct Egypt food-security relevance. Video search was thin and generic, so this stays a clean text card.

bannerItems.text: Dhu al-Hijjah 6 in Cairo; Eid al-Adha begins in four days.
Iran says its near-weapons-grade uranium will stay inside the country, hardening the biggest peace-talk sticking point.
OpenAI is preparing a confidential IPO filing that could kick off a September listing race.
Meta is cutting about 8,000 jobs while moving 7,000 workers into new AI teams.
Garden Grove officials warned a leaking chemical tank could spill or explode after mass evacuations.
Iran's new Hormuz vetting and fee system is now shaping who moves oil through the choke point.
SpaceX's filing puts AI infrastructure, not just rockets, at the center of the biggest IPO story on the board.
Egypt's published tariff sheet shows bigger electricity hikes for major users than the early framing suggested.
Anthropic is close to a $30B-plus round that could push its valuation above $900B.
Egypt is pitching a grain hub strategy with Russian exporters, storage, and processing built into the plan.
